title: Check a token before the next step
subtitle: PEPE · Ethereum
summary: Read token security flags, then see the sampled top-holder concentration.
limits: GoPlus signals and sampled holders. No audit, full distribution, Gini, or transfer alerts.
prompt: Scan PEPE on Ethereum and read its top-holder sample. Explain the available flags and concentration, including missing fields. Budget: 0.008 USDC.

title: Compare ETH funding signals
subtitle: Hyperliquid × dYdX v4
summary: Compare hourly current and predicted funding rates with the provider timestamps.
limits: Indicative spread only. Current and predicted rates differ; fees, basis risk, and execution costs excluded.
prompt: Get ETH funding from Hyperliquid and dYdX. Compare the hourly rates, identify current versus predicted data, and explain the limits. Budget: 0.008 USDC.

title: Estimate one swap route + gas
subtitle: 1 ETH → USDC · Ethereum
summary: Read a ParaSwap aggregate route, then compare it with current chain gas estimates.
limits: One aggregator route, no independent DEX comparison. Quote can expire; gas units and USD costs are estimates. No swap executed.
prompt: Quote 1 ETH to USDC on Ethereum using ParaSwap, then fetch gas tiers. Explain expected output and estimated gas separately. Do not execute a swap. Budget: 0.003 USDC.
